name: Muhammad Amin Bahadur Khan
contribution: The 7th Khan of the Uzbek Kungrat dynasty in the Khanate of Khiva.

checks.lead: Muhammad Amin Bahadur Khan (Turki and Persian: محمد امین بهادر خان; Khiva, 1817 - Sarahs, 1855), was the 7th Khan of the Uzbek Kungrat dynasty in the Khanate of Khiva. He reigned between 1845 and 1855, when he was killed in battle.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
